scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the scheduled holding-tank pump-out before Sunday use without turning the service visit into a wasted stop.
Emerging Need: The threaded deck-waste adapter required for tomorrow’s pump-out is no longer in the sanitation bin, and a marina loaner is only obtainable before the office closes.
Decision Context: Stored onboard notes identify the exact adapter requirement, while marina contact records determine the reservation route and cutoff-relevant contact.
Consequence: After the office locks, the appointment can still arrive, but the missing adapter leaves the needed pump-out benefit unavailable until a later service window.

parameter.subject: Sunday holding-tank pump-out confirmed
parameter.body: Confirming Blue Bay Pump-Out for Sunday, January 18, 8:30-8:50 AM at Sausalito Marina slip C-18. Please keep cockpit access clear and the deck waste cap reachable. Our route locks at 5:00 PM today; an attended stop that cannot be serviced remains on the route log.

parameter.title: Blue Bay holding-tank pump-out
parameter.description: Pump-out service at slip C-18; clear cockpit access and uncover deck waste cap before arrival.

parameter.content: I finished returning the sanitation-bin labels and spare hose washers to your cockpit locker. I found the cap key and washers, but no threaded pump-out adapter. The cracked adapter from last month is still in the discard crate, not the bin.

parameter.subject: Dock office counter closes at 3:30 today
parameter.body: Resident notice: the dock office counter and service cabinet checkout close at 3:30 PM today for fire-system testing. Any staff-checkout item needed this weekend must be named before the office locks. There will be no after-hours handoffs during the test.

parameter.content: The office is locked for the fire-system test now. Loaner checkout keys are sealed until Sunday at 9:00 AM; please do not pull anything from the service cabinet before staff reopen it.
